Murphy Oil Corporation Announces Third Quarter Results Exceeded Upper End of Production Guidance Achieved Exploration Success in Vietnam Advanced Appraisal Program Offshore Côte d’Ivoire
Initiated First Oil at Lac Da Vang (Golden Camel) Offshore Vietnam Commenced Production from Chinook #8 in the Gulf of America Raised Full Year 2026 Production Guidance
HOUSTON, Texas, November 4, 2026 – Murphy Oil Corporation (NYSE: MUR) today announced its financial and operating results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026. As a supplement to this release, Murphy has also furnished a Quarterly Stockholder Update. Unless otherwise noted, the financial and operating highlights and metrics discussed in this commentary exclude noncontrolling interest (NCI).†

Highlights for the third quarter include: •Produced 186,500 BOEPD, above quarterly guidance of 171,000 to 179,000 BOEPD, driven by accelerated Eagle Ford Shale activity, new well outperformance and lower royalties in the Tupper Montney, and minimal storm downtime in the Gulf of America •Raised full-year production guidance to a range of 176,000 to 178,000 BOEPD, reflecting a 6,000 BOEPD midpoint increase •Advanced the Bubale appraisal program offshore Côte d’Ivoire, with the Bubale West-1X well encountering approximately 88 feet of net oil pay in the Turonian reservoir and additional hydrocarbons in the deeper Albian reservoir •Discovered oil at the Lac Da Trang (White Camel) North-1X exploration well offshore Vietnam, encountering approximately 131 feet of net oil pay •Achieved first oil from the Lac Da Vang (Golden Camel) development offshore Vietnam, less than three years after project sanction •Commenced production from the Chinook #8 development well in the Gulf of America, with production in line with expectations •Brought online 14 operated and four non-operated wells in the Eagle Ford Shale and eight wells in the Tupper Montney Subsequent to the third quarter: •Secured six exploration blocks from the August Gulf of America federal offshore lease sale •Signed agreements with the government of Mauritania for two offshore exploration blocks “The results we delivered this quarter reflect our ability to create value at every stage of the asset life cycle. From finding oil to efficiently bringing it online and reliably operating our assets, this breadth of capabilities is what differentiates Murphy,” stated Eric M. Hambly, President and Chief Executive Officer. SHAREHOLDER RETURNS During the third quarter of 2026, Murphy paid $50 million in quarterly dividends to the shareholders. While the Company elected not to repurchase shares in the third quarter, it retains significant flexibility with $550 million remaining under its share repurchase authorization. As of September 30, 2026, there were 143.4 million shares outstanding. 2
FINANCIAL POSITION Murphy had approximately $2.50 billion of liquidity on September 30, 2026, comprised of the undrawn $2.00 billion senior unsecured credit facility and approximately $500 million of cash and cash equivalents, inclusive of NCI. As of September 30, 2026, Murphy’s total debt was $1.63 billion, approximately $80 million higher than the prior quarter, reflecting the recognition of a finance lease for the Lac Da Vang FSO (Floating Storage and Offloading) vessel in Vietnam through 2039. The Company’s $1.54 billion of long-term, fixed-rate notes have a weighted average maturity of 8.4 years and a weighted average coupon of 6.3 percent. PRODUCTION AND CAPITAL EXPENDITURE GUIDANCE The Company is raising its full year 2026 production range to 176,000 to 178,000 BOEPD, consisting of approximately 48 percent oil and 54 percent liquids volumes. This represents a 6,000 BOEPD increase in the midpoint of the previous range. The table below illustrates fourth quarter and full year 2026 guidance.

CONFERENCE CALL AND WEBCAST SCHEDULED FOR NOVEMBER 5, 2026 Murphy will host a conference call to discuss third quarter 2026 financial and operating results on Thursday, November 5, 2026, at 9:00 a.m. ET. The call can be accessed either via the Internet through the events calendar on the Murphy Oil Corporation Investor Relations website at http://ir.murphyoilcorp.com or via telephone by dialing toll free 833-461-5787, conference ID 940122717. For additional information, please refer to the Third Quarter 2026 Earnings Presentation and Quarterly Stockholder Update available under the News and Events section of the Investor Relations website. FINANCIAL DATA Summary financial data and operating statistics for third quarter 2026, with comparisons to the same period from the previous year, are contained in the attached schedules. Additionally, a schedule indicating the impacts of items affecting comparability of results between periods and a reconciliation of the non-GAAP financial measures of adjusted net income from continuing operations attributable to Murphy, EBITDA, EBITDAX, adjusted EBITDA, adjusted EBITDAX, free cash flow and adjusted free cash flow to the most directly comparable GAAP financial measures for such periods are also included. ABOUT MURPHY OIL CORPORATION Murphy Oil Corporation is an independent oil and natural gas company with a multi-basin onshore and offshore portfolio and significant exploration opportunities. The Company has more than a century-long history of demonstrating strong execution and innovative, full-cycle development capabilities with a focus on value creation that drives shareholder returns. Murphy’s foresight and financial discipline, along with its culture of adaptability and accountability, will allow the Company to continue its outstanding legacy and exceptional reputation. The Company’s current operations include extensive inventory located onshore in the Eagle Ford Shale, Tupper Montney and Kaybob Duvernay, as well as offshore in the Gulf of America and Canada. Murphy also strives to create long-term shareholder value through offshore exploration and development in the Gulf of America, Vietnam and Côte d’Ivoire. Additional information can be found on the Company’s website at www.murphyoilcorp.com.
